items.q: oh there's Bruce (Bitwas) the regular drummer who plays the #traps#

ctx.x: Every time they hear I'm going to play somewhere they come dashing down with their little box of things and play. They are ready to play with the band. (LAUGHTER).

But the other fellow, Palmer Lambkin, he's a composer and he'll be heard from one of these days. He's very serious about it and good. That's all the rhythm now. That's all the instruments that are not wind instruments. Those are all, that's like, oh there's Bruce (Bitwas) the regular drummer who plays the #traps# And the two percussion players, Palmer Lambkin and Sue Evans and (Airto) sometimes. And & Dick Horowitz & on the synthesizer and Ted
